description: Estonian company annual accounts: annual-report key figures from the official e-Business Register open data (RIK, CC BY 4.0, refreshed MONTHLY): EVERY published financial year since 2019 in one call: balance sheet (assets, equity, current/non-current liabilities, cash), revenue, employee expense, depreciation, operating profit, profit before tax, net profit and average FTE headcount, in EUR as published (null = not published, never zero). Statutory and consolidated figures kept apart. Filings submitted as PDF only carry no structured figures and are not served. A sole proprietorship (FIE) or an unrecognised legal form returns 404, not billed. No default-risk score is computed for this country yet: the response carries score_defaillance (statut non_evaluable, closed-list reasons explained by GET /v1/lecture); never read it as a low score. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

registrikood.description: 8-digit Estonian registry code (registrikood, e-Business Register), e.g. 10003666

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_estonian_company_accounts

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Estonian annual accounts
